name: Tenuous Truce
oracle_text:
Enchant opponent
At the beginning of enchanted opponent's end step, you and that player each draw a card.
When you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.
blocked_sentences: When you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.

needs.what: a `defending` value on `creatures_attack_player` meaning "the seat this Aura is attached to OR a planeswalker that player controls" -- i.e. the event's folded defender seat compared against the Aura's attached_to_player, without the seat-only restriction. The other half of the sentence ("when they attack you or a planeswalker you control") is already sayable as `creatures_attack_player` with `controller: any`, `defending: you` and condition `{is_active_player: enchanted_player}`; the end-step draw and Enchant opponent are also sayable (Overencumbered / Archnemesis shapes)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `defending: enchanted_player` (triggers._defender_matches) deliberately requires at least one attacker declared at the seat itself and rejects attacks aimed only at that player's planeswalkers, which is Archnemesis's narrower sentence. `defending: opponent` fires on attacks at any opponent, not just the enchanted one. No condition or value can compare the event's `{binding: defender}` seat to the enchanted player: `attacking_player` takes only you/opponent/any/most_life or a binding, and is seat-only too
